description.en: The 5.8 GHz FPV video-transmitter antenna class with an SMA plug: its coupling nut threads onto the SMA jack of the transmitter or of a bulkhead pigtail held by an antenna mount.
description.es: La clase de antena de transmisor de video FPV de 5.8 GHz con conector SMA macho: su tuerca de acoplamiento se enrosca en el conector SMA del transmisor o de un cable con pasamuros sujeto por un soporte de antena.
description.fr: La classe d'antenne d'émetteur vidéo FPV 5,8 GHz à fiche SMA : son écrou d'accouplement se visse sur l'embase SMA de l'émetteur ou d'une rallonge de traversée tenue par un support d'antenne.
description.pt: A classe de antena de transmissor de vídeo FPV de 5,8 GHz com ficha SMA: a porca de acoplamento enrosca no conector SMA do transmissor ou de um cabo de passagem preso por um suporte de antena.

governing.designation: 5.8 GHz FPV video antenna, SMA plug (COTS class)

sources.title: Amphenol RF Europe catalogue — SMA specification sheets (p. 24)
sources.supports: SMA jack coupling thread .250-36UNS-2A; plug coupling nut .250-36UNS-2B

sources.title: Foxeer Lollipop 4 SMA antenna 5.8 GHz RHCP
sources.supports: SMA connector; 11 × 60 mm; 7.8 g; 5.5–6.0 GHz; RHCP

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the coupling nut's mating face, on the connector axis. +z runs along the antenna away from the connector; +x is an arbitrary radial reference.

interfaces.note: Polarity is mechanical: the coupling nut's internal thread receives the jack's external .250-36 thread, so the antenna side is female although RF naming calls an SMA plug 'male'. RP-SMA shares the thread and is not distinguished by this key.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P4-STD lane, 2026-10-02); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: A class entry: the SMA coupling thread is the shared fact; size and mass are those of the cited Foxeer antenna.

envelope.note: The cited antenna's body diameter over its length (Foxeer; the class varies).
